h: NDC alleges attempt on life of Kwankwasiyya influencer Maryam Golden
p: The NDC's Kano campaign council has alleged that four masked, armed men broke into the home of social media personality Maryam Golden on Tuesday night. It described the incident as an assassination attempt.
body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) campaign council in Kano State has raised the alarm over what it described as an assassination attempt on Maryam Golden, a prominent social media personality who promotes the Kwankwasiyya movement online.

In a statement on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the council's director-general said four masked men carrying dangerous weapons broke into Ms Golden's home in the Rimin Kebe area of Kano at about 9pm on Tuesday.

The Kwankwasiyya movement is led by former Kano governor Rabiu Kwankwaso, who is now the NDC's vice-presidential candidate. The allegation comes amid growing concern about political violence ahead of the 2027 elections, following deadly attacks on NDC events in Delta and Edo states this week.
No statement from the police on the incident was included in the reports, and no arrests were reported.
more: Four masked men reportedly broke into her home.
The incident happened on Tuesday night in Kano.
